title: QBR Autopilot: AI-drafted quarterly client reviews for small MSPs
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: Turns an MSP's ticket history and Microsoft 365 data into a ready-to-edit quarterly business review (QBR) report for each client. Small MSPs often skip QBRs because preparing them takes hours.
hook: "I know I should show every client what we did this quarter, but preparing one review takes me half a day."
story:
**Mark owns a 6-person MSP with 30 small business clients.** He knows quarterly reviews keep clients loyal and open up upsells. But each one means exporting tickets from his PSA, sorting them by category, checking Microsoft 365 licences and writing slides.

So he does them for **only his biggest clients**. The others never see the value he delivers, and one of them recently left for a cheaper provider, saying "we never hear from you". Mark wants a **drafted QBR per client** that he can edit in ten minutes.
whyNow: In Kaseya's 2026 survey, staffing replaced tool sprawl as MSPs' biggest operational challenge, so tools that save technician hours sell better. 19% of MSPs say they cannot quickly show clients their value (search summary).
evidence: Staffing replaced tool sprawl as MSPs' biggest operational challenge in 2026 [Kaseya]
19% of MSPs say they cannot quickly show clients their value (search summary) [MSP Success]
ScalePad Lifecycle Insights listed from about $149/month; ScalePad bundles from $250/month [Software Advice / ScalePad]
